task: Find text-generation models on Hugging Face under 2B parameters with permissive licenses and not gated.
done_when: A list of top 3 models with their URLs and license information.

task: Open the Hugging Face page for each of the top 3 models and check the license and real size of its weights files. Item: {item}
done_when: The license and real size of the weights files for each of the top 3 models are verified.

task: Write and run a Python script that loads each of the 3 models on CPU and measures load time, memory used, and tokens per second.
done_when: The benchmark results for each of the 3 models are generated and verified.

task: Write and run a Python script that checks how many of 10 simple arithmetic questions each model answers correctly.
done_when: The accuracy of each of the 3 models in answering arithmetic questions is verified.

task: Write a ranked recommendation for Arnav based on the verified results from the benchmark and accuracy checks.
done_when: A ranked recommendation with sources is written and verified.
